title: Mortgage Calculator
h1: Mortgage Calculator — Monthly Payment, Interest and Amortization
seoTitle: Free Mortgage Calculator — Calculate Monthly Payment Online
description: Calculate monthly mortgage payments, total interest and loan cost from principal, rate and term. Private browser tool with no upload.
intro: Enter the loan amount, annual interest rate and term in years to see the monthly payment, total interest paid and overall cost of the mortgage.
blurb: Calculate monthly mortgage payment, total interest and total cost of a home loan.
howItWorks: Enter the principal loan amount, annual interest rate and the number of years.
Click Calculate. The monthly payment uses the standard amortization formula.
See the monthly payment, total amount paid and total interest over the full term.
examples: A $300,000 loan at 6.5% for 30 years costs about $1,896 per month.
Compare a 15-year versus 30-year term to see the interest savings.
Adjust the rate to model different lender offers.

faq.q: Does this include taxes or insurance?
faq.a: No. This calculates only principal and interest. Property taxes and insurance are usually added separately by the lender.
It uses the standard fixed-rate mortgage formula. Actual payments may vary slightly with compounding or fees.
No. All calculations happen locally in your browser.
